sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are in outstanding form with seven wins from their last ten games and currently sit top of the table with 22 points. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games and have lost their last five consecutive matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a fixture where the visitors will be looking to bounce back after recent inconsistency. In-form Bilston Town (5 wins, 2 draws from 8 games) face a stern test away at Foley Meir, who have won their last game. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table but coming off a rare defeat, travel to Eccleshall in what promises to be competitive. Wolverhampton Casuals, also in strong form, visit Wednesfield Community in a local derby. Struggling Crewe host Allscott Heath as both teams seek consistency, while Shawbury United entertain Barnton knowing they need points after a poor run. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a clash between mid-table sides with mixed recent form. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a battle between two of the division's weakest sides, and Brereton Social host Widnes Town—the latter having collected just 2 points all season.
